2. Identify unmappable fields: profile_tier, external_sso_id, last_sync_at have no equiv in AbstractBaseUser (lines 42-118)
3. Create intermediate migration: add new fields to temp table (django migrations/0002_*.py)
4. Switch inheritance: create new CustomUser(AbstractBaseUser) + managers.UserManager (managers.py:1-200)
5. Backfill unmappable fields: data migration copying values from old model
6. Update auth backends: ensure custom auth logic handles new field locations (backends.py)
7. Verify signals: check apps.py ready() hook for any User model signal handlers

unmappable_fields.migration_strategy: Add as custom field in CustomUser model extending AbstractBaseUser. Add to model definition after AbstractBaseUser inheritance, then create data migration to populate from old User.profile_tier values.
unmappable_fields.evidence: django/contrib/auth/models.py:42-118 (AbstractBaseUser declares only: password, last_login, is_active fields); lines 329-401 show AbstractUser adds: username, first_name, last_name, email, is_staff, is_superuser, date_joined but no profile_tier

unmappable_fields.reason: CharField with unique=True constraint and null=True is custom; AbstractBaseUser/AbstractUser provide no SSO integration or external identity fields
unmappable_fields.migration_strategy: Add custom CharField(unique=True, null=True, blank=True) to CustomUser model. Implement custom authentication backend (inherit from ModelBackend in django/contrib/auth/backends.py) to support SSO lookups via external_sso_id. Create data migration: backfill from old User model via intermediate shadow field.
unmappable_fields.evidence: django/contrib/auth/backends.py (ModelBackend ~lines 30-100) authenticates via username/email only; no external_sso_id support. AbstractUser (models.py:329) does not define unique external ID. Custom backend required to override authenticate() to check external_sso_id.

unmappable_fields.reason: DateTimeField(null=True) for SSO synchronization timestamp has no equivalent in contrib.auth; AbstractBaseUser only provides last_login (password auth login only, not SSO sync events)
unmappable_fields.migration_strategy: Add custom DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True) to CustomUser. Do NOT override last_login for SSO events (breaks standard auth). Create separate last_sync_at field. Update custom SSO integration code to write to last_sync_at instead of last_login on SSO events. Create data migration to preserve old timestamps.
unmappable_fields.evidence: django/contrib/auth/models.py:50-60 (AbstractBaseUser.last_login is DateTimeField for password auth only, linked to Session framework).
